sentences.t: 我不跟你要好了。
sentences.r: wǒ bù gēn nǐ yào hǎo le.
sentences.e: I'm going to stop trying to be friendly with you.

sentences.t: 你想知道我是怎么做的吗？
sentences.r: nǐ xiǎng zhīdào wǒ shì zěnme zuò de ma?
sentences.e: Would you like to know how I did that?

sentences.t: 我不知道你要来这里。
sentences.r: wǒ bù zhīdào nǐ yào lái zhèlǐ.
sentences.e: I didn't know you were going to be here.

sentences.t: 我不知道，我也不想知道。
sentences.r: wǒ bù zhīdào, wǒ yě bùxiǎng zhīdào.
sentences.e: I don't know and I don't want to know.

sentences.t: 你想说就说。
sentences.r: nǐ xiǎng shuō jiù shuō.
sentences.e: If you have something to say, just say it.

sentences.t: 我觉得什么都不说是最好的。
sentences.r: wǒ juéde shénme dōu bù shuō shì zuìhǎo de.
sentences.e: I found it best to say nothing about the matter.

sentences.t: 我知道他的样子，但不知道他的名字。
sentences.r: wǒ zhīdào tā de yàngzi, dàn bù zhīdào tā de míngzì.
sentences.e: I know him by sight, but not by name.

sentences.t: 我不知道，我现在应该做什么。
sentences.r: wǒ bù zhīdào, wǒ xiànzài yīnggāi zuò shénme.
sentences.e: I don't know what I should be doing right now.

sentences.t: 我认识他但是我不知道他的名字。
sentences.r: wǒ rènshí tā dànshì wǒ bù zhīdào tā de míngzì.
sentences.e: I know him, but I don't know his name.

sentences.t: 你确定要我什么都不说？
sentences.r: nǐ quèdìng yào wǒ shénme dōu bù shuō?
sentences.e: Are you sure you don't want me to say anything?

sentences.t: 我才是那个想和你在一起的人！
sentences.r: wǒ cái shì nàge xiǎng hé nǐ zài yìqǐ de rén!
sentences.e: I'm the one who wants to be with you.

sentences.t: 你还有什么事情需要我去做的吗？
sentences.r: nǐ háiyǒu shénme shìqíng xūyào wǒ qù zuò de ma?
sentences.e: Is there anything else you want me to do?

sentences.t: 如果我知道真相，我就告诉你了。
sentences.r: rúguǒ wǒ zhīdào zhēnxiàng, wǒ jiù gàosù nǐ le.
sentences.e: If I'd known the truth, I'd have told you.

sentences.t: 我不知道你是否和我有一样的感觉。

sentences.t: 我感觉你想告诉我什么事。

sentences.t: 我知道你还是想跟我一起。

sentences.t: 你是想耍我吗？

sentences.t: 我不知道她想不想和我一起去。

sentences.e: I don't know if she wants to go with me.

sentences.t: 我知道你不想跟我说话。

sentences.e: I think we should be able to go wherever we want to.

sentences.t: 让我来告诉你我不赞成你的理由。
sentences.r: ràng wǒ lái gàosù nǐ wǒ bù zànchéng nǐ de lǐyóu.
sentences.e: Let me tell you the reasons that I don't agree with you.

sentences.t: 虽然我很累，但是我已经做了我能做的了。
sentences.r: suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ yǐjīng zuò le wǒ néng zuò de le.
sentences.e: Although I was tired, I did what I was able to do.

sentences.t: 他们说了什么，我并不注意。
sentences.r: tāmen shuō le shénme, wǒ bìng bù zhùyì.
sentences.e: I didn't pay attention to what they were saying.

sentences.t: 我不喜欢你和我说话的口气。
sentences.r: wǒ bù xǐhuān nǐ hé wǒ shuōhuà de kǒuqì.
sentences.e: I don't like the way you talk to me.

sentences.t: 我就只告诉你，我不喜欢我们的新队长。
sentences.r: wǒ jiù zhǐ gàosù nǐ, wǒ bù xǐhuān wǒmen de xīn duìzhǎng.
sentences.e: Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.

sentences.t: 我承认他说的是事实。
sentences.r: wǒ chéngrèn tā shuō de shì shìshí.
sentences.e: I recognize that what he says is the truth.

sentences.t: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。
sentences.r: wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò tā zài de shíhòu búyào shuō zhèjiàn shì.
sentences.e: I told you not to mention that in her presence.

sentences.t: 你知道她有多么爱你吗?
sentences.r: nǐ zhīdào tā yǒu duōme ài nǐ ma ?
sentences.e: Are you aware of how much she loves you?

sentences.t: 我有一个朋友, 他的父亲是老师。
sentences.r: wǒ yǒu yígè péngyǒu ,   tā de fùqīn shì lǎoshī.
sentences.e: I have a friend whose father is a teacher.

sentences.t: 你真的知道这个怎么做吗？
sentences.r: nǐ zhēnde zhīdào zhège zěnme zuò ma?
sentences.e: Are you sure you know how to do this?

sentences.t: 有人说你是个很有能力的人。
sentences.r: yǒurén shuō nǐ shì gè hěn yǒu nénglì de rén.
sentences.e: I've been told that you're a very competent person.

sentences.t: 我不能让自己做这样的事。
sentences.r: wǒ bùnéng ràng zìjǐ zuò zhèyàng de shì.
sentences.e: I can't bring myself to do such a thing.

sentences.t: 我让他随我来，他同意了。
sentences.r: wǒ ràng tā suí wǒ lái, tā tóngyì le.
sentences.e: I asked him to come with me and he agreed.

sentences.t: 我所知道的是他放弃了这个计划。
sentences.r: wǒ suǒ zhīdào de shì tā fàngqì le zhège jìhuà.
sentences.e: All that I know is that he gave up the plan.

sentences.t: 如果你不去音乐会, 我也不去。
sentences.r: rúguǒ nǐ bù qù yīnyuèhuì ,   wǒ yě bù qù.
sentences.e: If you are not going to the concert, then neither am I.

sentences.t: 如果你愿意，你可以用我的车。
sentences.r: rúguǒ nǐ yuànyì, nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de chē.
sentences.e: If you want to, you can use my car.

sentences.t: 我不知道你不会游泳。
sentences.r: wǒ bù zhīdào nǐ búhuì yóuyǒng.
sentences.e: I didn't know you didn't know how to swim.

sentences.t: 你找我的房子有困难吗？
sentences.r: nǐ zhǎo wǒ de fángzi yǒu kùnnán ma?
sentences.e: Did you have any difficulty in finding my house?

sentences.t: 如果我知道的话，我早就已经告诉你了。
sentences.r: rúguǒ wǒ zhīdào dehuà, wǒ zǎojiù yǐjīng gàosù nǐ le.
sentences.e: Had I known about it, I would have told you.

sentences.t: 你是决定做这个工作的那个人，对吗？
sentences.r: nǐ shì juédìng zuò zhège gōngzuò de nàge rén, duì ma?
sentences.e: You're the one who decided to do this job, right?

sentences.t: 我搞明白了会告诉你。
sentences.r: wǒ gǎo míngbái le huì gàosù nǐ.
sentences.e: I'll let you know when I've figured it out.

sentences.t: 你就只告诉我一个人，你对她的意见如何？
sentences.r: nǐ jiù zhǐ gàosù wǒ yígè rén, nǐ duì tā de yìjiàn rúhé?
sentences.e: Between you and me, what is your opinion of her?

sentences.t: 我看了他一段时间。
sentences.r: wǒ kàn le tā yīduànshíjiān.
sentences.e: I looked after him for a period of time.
